post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller’s full name, as they spelled it.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: The best number to call the caller back on, if different from the number they called from.

post_call_analysis_data.name: email
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller’s email address, only if they gave one.

post_call_analysis_data.name: new_or_returning
post_call_analysis_data.description: Returning if they said they are already a Gainora client (or their name matched the record for their number); otherwise new.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: "15-minute diagnostic call" if they booked it or asked for it; otherwise empty.

post_call_analysis_data.name: preferred_times
post_call_analysis_data.description: The days and times that suit them, in their words.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: The main reason for the call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the 15-minute diagnostic call was booked with book_appointment on this call. Never true for a role-play.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked_for
post_call_analysis_data.description: If booked: the agreed date and time as ISO 8601 with the UK offset, for example 2026-11-14T10:00:00+00:00. Leave empty if no exact time was agreed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked_with
post_call_analysis_data.description: If booked: the first name of the team member the appointment is with, if one was agreed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent_concern
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if an existing client said something of theirs isn’t working (their receptionist, texts, website or inbox). Never true for a role-play.

post_call_analysis_data.name: business_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller’s own business name, if they gave it.

post_call_analysis_data.name: business_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: What their business does, in a few words (for example "electricians, 2 vans" or "aesthetics clinic").

post_call_analysis_data.name: interested_in
post_call_analysis_data.description: The Gainora package they were most interested in.

post_call_analysis_data.name: roleplay
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if you played a receptionist for their business on this call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_language
post_call_analysis_data.description: The language most of the call was in.
